name: face-touch-alert
description: A real-time web application that helps users build awareness of unconscious face-touching behaviors through computer vision and instant audio alerts. Perfect for individuals managing anxiety-related habits, skin picking disorders, nail biting, or general face touching patterns that interfere with skincare, hygiene, or focus.

scripts.package:offline: npm run build:offline && rm -f face-touch-alert-offline.zip && cd dist-offline && zip -rq ../face-touch-alert-offline.zip .
